verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms that https://developer.folk.app/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index of the developer portal. Docs pages are also served as Markdown (.md) and explicitly tell agents to fetch the complete index from llms.txt, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. missing for 10: no llms-full.txt or machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all OpenAPI paths probed 404), no independent third-party corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
